lamps.steady: Parking brake is engaged or brake fluid is low. Stop safely and check brakes or consult workshop.

lamps.lamp: Driver and Front Passenger Seat Belt Reminder Light
lamps.steady: Driver or front passenger seat belt is unfastened. Fasten seat belts before driving.

lamps.lamp: Rear Seat Passenger Seat Belt Reminder Light
lamps.steady: Rear passenger seat belt is unfastened. Ensure all passengers buckle up.
Fuel level is low. Refuel as soon as possible.
ABS system malfunction detected. Have the vehicle inspected by an authorized workshop.

lamps.lamp: High Engine Coolant Temperature Warning Light
lamps.steady: Engine is overheating. Stop safely immediately and follow emergency overheating procedures.
lamps.flashing: Engine is running hot. Drive carefully and prepare to stop safely.

lamps.steady: Coolant temperature is low. Drive gently until engine reaches normal temperature.
Fault in emission control or automatic transmission system. Have vehicle inspected at an authorized workshop.
lamps.flashing: Engine misfire detected. Stop immediately in a safe place to prevent catalytic converter damage.

lamps.steady: Electric power steering fault detected. Have vehicle inspected by an authorized workshop.
Low engine oil pressure. Stop safely immediately and check oil level or consult workshop.
Lead-acid battery charging system fault. Have system inspected immediately by an authorized workshop.

lamps.lamp: Immobilizer / Keyless Push Start System Warning Light
lamps.steady: Remote key is outside vehicle or key battery is discharged.
lamps.flashing: Immobilizer fault or remote key not detected. Re-position key or inspect system.

lamps.steady: One or more doors are open. Close all doors securely before driving.
Automatic transmission malfunction. Have system inspected by an authorized workshop.
Turn signals or hazard lights are turned on.
lamps.flashing: Flashing indicates active turn signal or hazard lights operation.

lamps.steady: Headlight high beams are turned on.
Position lights or headlights are turned on.
Front fog lights are turned on.
ESP system is manually deactivated.
Fault in ESP system. Have system inspected by an authorized workshop.
lamps.flashing: ESP system is actively intervening to stabilize the vehicle. Drive carefully.

lamps.steady: Engine is automatically stopped by ENG A-STOP system.
lamps.flashing: Engine is automatically restarting due to system request or vehicle condition.

lamps.steady: ENG A-STOP system is manually deactivated.
lamps.flashing: Fault in ENG A-STOP system, lithium battery, or lead-acid battery replacement needed.

lamps.steady: Vehicle security system is armed.
lamps.flashing: Security system triggered or arming process active.

lamps.steady: Fault in lithium-ion battery system. Have vehicle inspected at an authorized workshop.
GPF is nearly clogged. Keep driving above 50 km/h and 2000 rpm for 25 minutes.
Deceleration energy regeneration is active during braking or coasting.
Parking sensors stopped temporarily or failed. Clean sensors or consult workshop.

lamps.lamp: Blind Spot Monitor (BSM) OFF Indicator Light
lamps.steady: Blind Spot Monitor system is manually turned off or suspended.

lamps.lamp: Rear Cross Traffic Alert (RCTA) OFF Indicator Light
lamps.steady: Rear Cross Traffic Alert system is manually turned off or suspended.
One or more tyres significantly under-inflated. Stop safely, check tyres, and inflate to recommended pressure.
lamps.flashing: TPMS malfunction detected. Have system inspected by an authorized workshop.

lamps.steady: Warning message displayed on instrument cluster display. Follow displayed instructions.
lamps.flashing: Keyless start issue, system error, or sensor failure detected. Follow display instructions.

lamps.steady: Amber means ready, blue charging, green complete, red non-recoverable failure.
lamps.flashing: Red flashing means metallic object detected or phone overheating. Remove object and let cool.

lamps.steady: eCall emergency system is operating normally.
lamps.flashing: eCall emergency operation active or communication established.
